forces.title: Increased demand from defence and security customers
forces.description: UK manufacturers are experiencing increased demand from defence and security customers, with 72% of leaders reporting this trend. This points to a broader expansion and investment within the security landscape. For Security Services (IN030304), this increased focus and expenditure in the wider security market creates a positive operating environment, potentially driving demand for physical guarding, alarm monitoring, and aviation security operations as part of overall enhanced security postures.
forces.source_title: Manufacturing: the gears driving Britain’s growth

forces.title: Continued investment in airports boosts aviation security operations
forces.description: The Bank of England Agents' summary reports that airports continue to invest, alongside ports. Given that 'aviation security operations' are a defined component of Security Services (IN030304), ongoing investment in airport infrastructure and services will naturally lead to sustained or increased demand for these specialized security functions. This provides a direct tailwind for companies operating in the aviation security segment of the Security Services sector in the UK.
forces.source_title: Agents' summary of business conditions - September 2026

viewpoints.title: Growing demand from defence and security markets positively impacting manufacturing
viewpoints.description: Barclays highlights that UK manufacturers are increasingly optimistic about growth opportunities driven by demand from defence, security, and critical infrastructure markets. Specifically, 72% of manufacturing leaders report increased demand from defence and security customers. This indicates a robust and growing market for security-related needs, which, while directly impacting manufacturers supplying goods, signals a positive broader environment for security services, including physical security guarding and aviation security operations, as overall investment and activity in the security domain rises.
viewpoints.source_title: Manufacturing: the gears driving Britain’s growth
